items.title: Roscoe Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 23, 2023
items.q: My CDs “Conversations” numbers 1 and 2 with Craig Taborn and Kikanju Baku I transcribed our improvisations and turned those into like pieces for orchestra.

ctx.x: I can recall sort of a realization as I was listening to jazz back when I was about your age and starting to sort out the way the music worked, the accompanist, the soloist, maybe starting to realize about song form. Do you recall that sort of realization coming to you?

Well yeah and I took that even further I mean you know ‘cause I’m a composer as well. So I have several pieces and CDs and so on that I’ve put out with the orchestra that I founded when I was teaching at Mills College you know. So yeah, let’s see hold it, I’ve lost my thought for a minute — I’ve got out several CDs of this — and one of my CDs © Fillius Jazz Archive -3-

won the New York Times Award of the Year. And the thing about it is that what I did was went out to Mills College and put together my own 36-piece chamber orchestra and then recorded them all. I work with Gregory Howe of Wide Hive Records, a man that was wide open to new ideas and so on and so forth. My CDs “Conversations” numbers 1 and 2 with Craig Taborn and Kikanju Baku I transcribed our improvisations and turned those into like pieces for orchestra.
